TS0280001.solution: Only certain actions are valid from each state; check the pipeline's current state first.

TS0280002.message: The pipeline's revision {requested} is not compatible with the latest applied revision {latest}.
TS0280002.solution: Re-apply the pipeline so its revision matches the latest applied one, then retry.

TS0280003.message: Stopping pipeline {pipeline} did not say whether to clear what it has accumulated.
TS0280003.solution: Send purgeState true to stop and clear this pipeline's resume position and operator state, or purgeState false to stop and keep them; there is no default because the next run either continues or reads the whole source again.

TS0280004.message: Pipeline {pipeline} is an incomplete editor draft and cannot be started.
TS0280004.solution: Add at least one Source and a view or serve output, save the Pipeline, then start it.

TS0280005.solution: Apply the pipeline before acting on it or reading its status, and check the id for typos.

TS0280006.message: Pipeline {pipeline} was not started: {count} start check question(s) need an answer first. Answer them with a client that shows start checks, or run tapstate start {pipeline} --decide <check>=<action>, or -y to go ahead as configured. First: {check} on {subject}.
TS0280006.solution: Read the start checks, answer each question, and start again with the answers.

TS0280007.message: Pipeline {pipeline} was not started: {count} start check(s) refuse this start whatever is answered. First: {check} on {subject}.
TS0280007.solution: Read the start checks for what each refusal needs changed, change it, then start again.

TS0280008.message: Pipeline {pipeline} was not started: the answer {action} to start check {finding} cannot be taken, because it is not offered, is repeated, or conflicts with another answer.
TS0280008.solution: Answer each question once, with one of its offered actions. Targets sharing a write element must agree: do not mix clear and keep for that element.
